sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: head deep black, shiny, mandibles and antennae brownish black, thoracic and abdominal tergites deep brownish black, legs pale yellow with the tibiae tinged with brown; head oval, longer than wide, the vertex slightly concave in the middle, the punctiform frontal gland in the centre of the depression; compound eyes highly convex, slightly oval, their anterior margin touching the antennal socket; ocelli small, circular, raised, more than their long diameter from the compound eyes. Antenna 14-segmented, segment 3 very small, segment 2 about as long as segments 3 and 4 together. Pronotum trapezoidal, the anterior margin short and upturned, the posterior margin shallowly concave. Body length with wings 10.00—10.60 mm, without wings 6.6—7.1 mm, fore wing length 8.00—8.50 mm, head width 1.1—1.4 mm, pronotum width 0.85—0.92 mm, length 0.55 mm. Soldier head yellowish brown, slightly darker anteriorly, mandibles brown; head obtusely oval, flat, narrowed in the anterior quarter, rounded behind, labrum pentagonal, mandibles sickle-curved with strong teeth in the basal half; antenna 13-segmented, segment 3 short, segments 2 and 4 each about twice as long as segment 3; body length 4.32—5.00 mm, head length including mandibles 2.70—2.80 mm, excluding mandibles 1.73—1.85 mm, head width 1.20—1.25 mm. Worker head rounded-square with eye spots, antenna 13-segmented, body length 3.8—4.8 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head deep black, shiny, anteclypeus and labrum slightly paler; mouthparts and antennae brownish black; thoracic tergites, abdominal tergites and sternites, and all the more strongly sclerotized parts of the body deep brownish black; the first 4 sternites in the male and all sternites in the female paler in the middle; intersegmental membranes of the abdomen yellowish white; legs pale yellow, the tibiae tinged with brown. Head and body rather densely hairy. Head oval, longer than wide, the vertex slightly concave in the middle; a granular frontal gland in the centre of that depression. Compound eyes highly convex, slightly oval, their anterior margin touching the antennal socket. Ocelli small, circular, raised, directed obliquely forward, the upper margin slightly projecting, the lower margin concave; more than their long diameter from the compound eyes and still further from the antennae. Anteclypeus flatly convex, long and wide, the anterior margin nearly straight, the posterior margin rounded, with a shallow groove along the midline. Labrum wider than long, rounded and convex, with a shallow groove along the midline. Antenna 14-segmented, segment 3 very small, segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together. Pronotum trapezoidal, the anterior margin short and upturned, the posterior margin weakly concave. Wings punctate, with short setae only on the costal margin; media of the fore wing with 1—3 branches, cubitus with 7—8 branches, usually not reaching the apical third of the wing. Body length with wings 10.00—10.60 mm, body length without wings 6.6—7.1 mm, fore wing length 8.00—8.50 mm, head width 1.1—1.4 mm, pronotum width 0.85—0.92 mm, length 0.55 mm. Mature queen body length 21 mm, width 5 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, slightly darker anteriorly; mandibles brown; antennae, labrum, mouthparts, body and legs pale yellow. Head and body with fine short hairs. Head obtusely oval, flat, narrowed in the anterior quarter, rounded behind, the frons sloping down flatly forward; head sutures and frontal gland indistinct. Labrum pentagonal, the sides nearly parallel, the anterior end tapering to an almost right angle. Mandibles sickle-curved, the teeth of the basal half rather strong, followed by weaker teeth up to the preapical third. Antenna 13-segmented, segment 3 short, segments 2 and 4 each about twice as long as segment 3; from segment 4 on, the segments fusiform and longer than wide. Pronotum with a wide, upturned, rounded anterior lobe without a notch; the posterior part of the disc with a wide triangular depression. Lateral and posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum broadly convex. Body length 4.32—5.00 mm; head length including mandibles 2.70—2.80 mm, excluding mandibles 1.73—1.85 mm; head width 1.20—1.25 mm; pronotum width 0.63—0.67 mm, length 0.35—0.38 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Of two sizes, major and minor. Head darker or paler yellowish brown, markedly brownish in mature individuals, the sagittal and frontal sutures rather shallow; head rounded-square in shape. Both morphs have eye spots behind the antennae. Anteclypeus raised, with a shallow groove in the middle. Antenna 13-segmented, segment 3 small (very small in the minor worker). Pronotum upturned, without a notch, with a groove in the posterior middle; meso- and metanotum with raised margins. Major worker: body length 4.60—4.80 mm, head width 1.10—1.13 mm, pronotum width 0.63—0.68 mm; minor worker: body length 3.8—4.32 mm, head width 0.95—0.97 mm, pronotum width 0.49—0.60 mm.

note: Adapted from the original description in Kemner (1932) "Neue Termiten aus der orientalischen Region. II" (Entomologisk Tidskrift 53: 133–155), original in German; the original is a description of a n. sp., with the alate, the queen, the soldier and the major and minor workers all described. The measurement tables of the original, Fig. 5 (alate and soldier head, mandibles) and the details of the type locality have not been entered item by item; the measurements follow the table values in the text. Suspected OCR errors: the alate "Kopfbreite 1.1—1.4" is probably 1.1—1.2, and the minor worker "0.97—0.95" has been entered as 0.95—0.97 according to the sense of the table; undeterminable values such as the minor worker head width have been entered from the legible figures.
